author: Barrie Linch
text: I'm happy with the sensor accuracy, as it is. I've used other sensors that have manual calibration and they have been less accurate than the Libre. If they improve the accuracy anyway, that's great but I don't believe manual calibration is the way. It's just one more way to drive ourselves mad.

author: William J. Hughes
text: Don't waste your time or money on this product. I've been using this product & 3+ sensors since 3/1/2025 and only three or four sensors have worked for the advertised 15 days. Yes, I've received replacement sensors in the past, but now I'm being told I'm not longer eligible for replacements because I've maxed out. So now I'm being penalized for their defective product. Time to switch  to Dexcom 7!
